unlisted_practices: Compiling clinical practice guideline diagnostic criteria into executable skill functions that return ordinal diagnostic-support scores and fusing them with LLM differential rankings
Evolving guideline-derived skills using case-diagnosis pairs to refine covered skills and add missing diagnoses
Expert clinician evaluation of the soundness and acceptability of generated diagnostic skills

screen.reason: The paper introduces a novel technical framework/agent architecture (GuideSkill) that compiles guidelines into executable functions and benchmarks it against standard RAG and direct inference; it does not evaluate an operational deployment practice or organizational safeguard.
